card.title: Approve the Harmless Version
card.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: May I put one extra chair in the hall?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. It's for the chair of my new tenants' committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I approved furniture, not a committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Just tell our chair when you are free to explain that distinction.
